settings.content: Shown in the footer, contact page and structured data. Use verified details only.

settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Used in page titles. Shopify's store name is still 'My Store': rename it in Settings > General too, because checkout and emails use that one.

settings.label: Free delivery above (Rs)
settings.info: Must match Settings > Shipping and delivery. Set 0 to hide the progress bar.

settings.label: Cart drawer suggestions
settings.info: Up to two available products from this collection that are not already in the cart. Defaults to New.

settings.content: Comma-separated product tags. They drive the mega menu, the concern shortcuts on collections, the product card benefit line and the facts on product pages. Tags must match the product tags exactly.

settings.label: Concern tags
settings.default: Hydration, Dullness, Dark spots, Breakouts, Fine lines, Firmness, Pores, Oil control, Redness, Sun protection, Dark circles, Puffiness, Makeup removal

settings.label: Skin type tags
settings.default: All skin types, Dry skin, Oily skin, Combination skin, Sensitive skin, Acne-prone skin, Normal skin

settings.label: Routine step tags
settings.default: Cleanse, Tone, Treat, Moisturise, Protect, Mask, Eye care, Lip care

settings.label: Kreol touches
settings.info: A few warm Mauritian Kreol words: Bonzour / Bonswar greetings, Mersi when something is added, Pa bizin traka in empty states, Byenvini on welcome screens. Check the wording with your team before launch.

settings.content: Offers the routine quiz in a pop-up once a shopper has been browsing for a little while. It never shows on the quiz page itself, to someone who already has a routine saved, or again for a while after she closes it. Preview it without switching it on by adding ?quiz_popup=1 to any page address.

settings.label: Seconds of browsing before it appears
settings.info: Counted from her first scroll, so it never interrupts a page she has only just opened.

settings.label: Days before it can show again after she closes it

settings.content: Shows points on product pages, in the bag, in the header and on the Rewards page. The theme only displays points: they are added by Shopify Flow or a loyalty app writing to the customer metafield below (see the handover notes). Confirm the numbers before launch.
